title: cucubalus conoideus
intro: Cucubalus conoideus, commonly known as alpine spurge, is a perennial plant species within the Euphorbiaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of alpine spurge include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, which can aid in treating wounds, skin irritations, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
